summary: No public dataset pairs wall anisotropy with directional extension in Spirogyra or any freely growing algal filament. The closest open data are for Arabidopsis: a 303 MB Dryad deposit (dryad.4s4b3nf, CC0) with wall mechanical anisotropy and elongation in hypocotyl cells, and IDR idr0032 with wall-synthase perturbation of meristem morphology; both are cells inside tissues, outside the claim's 'without external restraint' scope.
next_step: Either accept tissue-embedded plant cells as a proxy and pre-register on dryad.4s4b3nf, or image Spirogyra/Nitella filaments with polarized light or AFM to get microfibril orientation and axial vs radial strain in the same cells.
obstacles_confirmed: Spirogyra-specific perturbation data are limited (none found in BioImage Archive, IDR, Dryad, Zenodo).
Microfibril angle and growth anisotropy are published for model cells, not archived with the algal images.
